title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Termination for Convenience and Closed Proposals
content:
## Agreement terms: ending the agreement early

A building owner may end a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record before its term for convenience on written notice.

**Effective day.** The termination takes effect no earlier than the tier's notice period counted forward from the day the customer gives written notice of termination, counting calendar days with the notice day excluded and the final day included, and coverage continues until that effective day. The notice day is the one recorded on the written notice in the intake records against the agreement; the notice period is the tier's figure on the renewal and termination terms table.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 60-day notice period).* Written notice given on 1 March: day 1 is 2 March and day 60 is 30 April, so the earliest effective day is 30 April, and coverage continues through that day. A termination requested to take effect on 29 April is earlier than the notice period allows.

**Early termination fee.** The early termination fee is the tier's rate applied to the unbilled remainder of the term — the installments of the current term not yet invoiced at the effective day — and it is invoiced with the final installment; installments already invoiced stay due in full and visits already performed are never rebated. At a hypothetical tier billed quarterly with two installments of 900 USD not yet invoiced at the effective day and a fee rate of 25 percent, the unbilled remainder is 1800 USD and the fee is 25 percent of it, that is 450 USD.

**Sale or closure of the building.** An agreement cancelled because the building is sold or closed carries the notice period but no early termination fee, on proof of the sale or closure.

**Proposals that never activate.** A proposal that is declined or left unsigned past its validity carries no fee at all, and the pre-agreement inspection fee already charged stays charged because the inspection was performed.

| Way the agreement ends | Notice period applies | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|
| owner's termination for convenience | yes | the tier's rate on the unbilled remainder |
| building sold or closed, on proof | yes | none |
| proposal declined or left unsigned past validity | not applicable | none; the inspection fee already charged stays charged |
